stub_knowledge.title: Runbook: OOMKilled / CrashLoopBackOff triage
stub_knowledge.chunk: When a pod is OOMKilled (exit code 137) and enters CrashLoopBackOff, compare the container memory limit with actual usage under peak load. For JVM services, check heap settings (-Xmx) against the cgroup limit; heap near the limit (e.g. 912Mi/1024Mi) plus OutOfMemoryError in logs confirms memory pressure. Remediation candidates: raise the memory limit, lower -Xmx, or reduce batch size. Always involve a human before changing limits.

stub_knowledge.title: Runbook: JVM OutOfMemoryError in payment-api
stub_knowledge.chunk: payment-api loads pending settlements in a 24h window at startup of the batch thread. Large backlogs exhaust the heap. Check logs for 'java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space' and the number of settlement rows loaded. Consider paginating the settlement load or temporarily increasing the container memory limit.

stub_knowledge.title: Postmortem 2026-05: settlement batch OOM
stub_knowledge.chunk: Historical incident: settlement batch OOMKilled after a backlog of ~400k rows. Fixed by chunking the load and raising memory limits from 1Gi to 2Gi. Symptom signature: CrashLoopBackOff, OOMKilled, heap usage near limit.

useful_rubric_notes: Useful when the draft links OOMKilled/CrashLoopBackOff evidence to heap exhaustion and cites evidence + the OOM runbook.
